title: diary-detail
sql: SELECT serial_number AS title, status_label, CAST(record_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS DATE) AS record_date, source_variant AS variant FROM fact_daily_log WHERE is_business_log AND NOT is_deleted AND CAST(record_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS DATE) = DATE '2026-06-01' ORDER BY record_date DESC NULLS LAST, daily_log_id ASC, source_variant ASC LIMIT 20
